title: Marlowe Hotel | Weekend housekeeping trial
titleZh: 馬洛旅館｜週末房務試行
passage:
Please use the following instructions while we try to reduce unnecessary linen deliveries. An unopened spare linen pack can go back to the floor cupboard only if no guest has entered the room since the room was prepared. A porter dropping off a suitcase does not count as guest entry. A ‘guest key’ entry in the door log identifies the card used to open the door, not the person who carried it. If a guest asks us not to enter a room, cancel the room visit. A separate towel request should stay open unless the guest cancels it too. The desk can hold towels only when the guest has already chosen desk pickup.

There are three linen packs in the returns cart. Room 304's pack is still sealed. The guest stepped inside 304 at nine; the attendant prepared the room at ten. Then the log shows that a guest key was used. The porter had borrowed it to put a suitcase inside and returned it to the guest in the lobby. The guest did not go upstairs again. Room 307's pack is sealed and its guest key was not used. But just after the attendant finished preparing the room, she held the door open while the guest stepped inside. No guest entered 312, but a new attendant broke its pack's seal to check the contents. [139] _____

Before going out, the guest in 318 asked for two towels. She added, 'If I end up canceling the visit, please switch the towels to desk pickup.' She has now written, 'Please cancel the visit to the room. I'm going straight from the lobby to my meeting after all.' Her note does not mention towels. We should [140] _____.

We are considering sleeves for carrying spare cloths, which keep sliding off the top shelf. A sleeve fits beside the two hooks on a large cart but needs the space occupied by one hook on a small cart. Attendants carry two refill bottles on every cart, and the only places for them are the hooks, which hold one bottle apiece. Without changing how many bottles we carry, the sleeves can [141] _____.

A regular bath mat is still part of every room's setup. If one is missing, the floor team should replace it. The only change is that extras are no longer left in rooms by default; they are available on request from the cabinet at the desk. Two rooms called about mats. The floor team took the regular mat out of 205 during cleaning but did not leave a fresh one. Room 207 still has a regular mat but would like one more. We should [142] _____.
passageZh:
為了減少不必要的布巾配送，試行期間請遵守以下作法。未開封的備用布巾包，只有在客房準備好之後未曾有房客進入時，才能放回樓層備品櫃。行李員放進行李，不算房客進入。門鎖紀錄上的「房客房卡」表示開門時使用哪一張卡，不表示由誰持卡進入。如果房客要求我們不要進房，就取消進房服務。如果房客另有毛巾需求，除非他也一併取消，否則仍須保留。只有房客已選擇到櫃台領取，櫃台才能替他留毛巾。

退回物品的推車上有三包布巾。304 房的布巾包仍密封。房客九點進 304 房看過，房務員十點才準備好客房。之後門鎖紀錄顯示使用了房客房卡。行李員借卡進去放行李，之後在大廳把卡還給房客；房客沒有再次上樓。307 房的布巾包也仍密封，且房客房卡未被使用。不過房務員一準備好那間房，就扶著門讓房客走了進去。312 房沒有房客進入，但新進房務員已拆封確認內容。[139] _____

318 房的房客出門前要了兩條毛巾。她補充道：「如果我後來取消進房服務，請把毛巾改成到櫃台領取。」她現在寫道：「請取消進房服務。我改成直接從大廳去開會。」她的留言沒提到毛巾。我們應該[140] _____。

備用抹布常從推車上層滑出去，我們考慮加裝收納袋。大推車的兩個掛鉤旁邊還放得下一個袋子，但小推車得讓出其中一個掛鉤的位置才放得下。房務員每臺推車都要帶兩個補充瓶，而補充瓶只能掛在這些掛鉤上，每個掛鉤只能掛一瓶。如果不改變每臺推車攜帶的瓶數，收納袋可以[141] _____。

每間客房仍會按標準備有一片浴墊。如果缺了這片浴墊，由樓層房務人員補上。唯一的改變是客房不再預先放額外的浴墊；如有需要，可向櫃台索取櫃中備品。兩間房都打電話詢問浴墊。房務人員清潔時把 205 房原有的浴墊收走，但沒有換上新的。207 房還有原配的浴墊，只想多要一片。我們應該[142] _____。
